title: Free left internal modules over an arbitrary monoid object
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\otimes,\mathbf 1,\alpha,\lambda)$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category] and let $R$ be a monoid object with multiplication $\mu$ and unit $\eta$ [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]. Let $U_R:\operatorname{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)\to\mathcal C$ forget the left module structure [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For $X\in\mathcal C$, the object $R\otimes X$ has a left $R$-action $(\mu\otimes\mathrm{id}_X)\circ\alpha_{R,R,X}^{-1}$. With maps $\mathrm{id}_R\otimes h$ this gives a functor $F_R:\mathcal C\to\operatorname{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)$ and an adjunction $F_R\dashv U_R$. Explicitly, for each left module $(M,\gamma_M)$ there are natural inverse bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}_R(F_RX,M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,U_RM),\qquad
f\longmapsto U_R(f)\circ(\eta\otimes\mathrm{id}_X)\circ\lambda_X^{-1},\qquad
 g\longmapsto\gamma_M\circ(\mathrm{id}_R\otimes g).$$
No braiding, additivity, commutativity of $R$, or existence of any limits or colimits is assumed.
